requiredFindings.reason: The case file says 'Executed results in receipt', and the boundaries doc says 'Task evidence records actual restored/compiled/package inspection and raw test results'. The working tree has no new or modified T02 receipt, evidence file or roadmap/status entry. Only the case inventory, docs, scope/amendment records, tests and an unrelated Web/Properties directory are present. As submitted, the 15-passed-cases claim and the repack/positive-recovery narrative rest on evidence that is not in the change set. AGENTS.md requires distinguishing executed evidence from claims, and treats the roadmap/status, case inventory and native reports as completion evidence.
requiredFindings.fix: Before committing, add the T02 receipt. It should contain the exact test command, TRX or raw output for all 15 focused rows (11 new copied-mutation rows, 4 compiled rows), the stale-candidate positive failure and post-repack success, the commit/package version and the platform. Update the roadmap/status entry to match. If the receipt is intentionally written after review, keep the doc and case-file wording conditional until then.

optionalFindings.reason: This looks like tool-generated launch settings from running the Type Manager Web example. It is outside T02 scope, and the boundaries doc explicitly says the Type Manager implementation is not modified.
optionalFindings.fix: Exclude it from the T02 commit. Delete it or ignore it after confirming it holds no user edits.

optionalFindings.reason: The doc says the checker evaluates 'the whole generated package'. The nuspec check does not inspect <frameworkReferences> groups or dependency include/exclude attributes. For example, exclude="Runtime" or include="None" would silently weaken the approved dependency for consumers. Project-level FrameworkReference checks cover the source path, but the package path is checked independently and can be stale or modified. No new rows are strictly required by T02.
optionalFindings.fix: Either narrow the wording to 'asset list, dependency groups/ids/versions and packed DLL references', or add closed checks for nuspec frameworkReferences and include/exclude, with one mutation row each.

optionalFindings.reason: The nuspec controls cover replace, add, version and range, but not removing the approved direct dependency. That would turn the transitive closure into an undeclared runtime requirement for consumers. The count check would reject it, but no row proves this.
optionalFindings.fix: Add a 'dependency-removed' DataRow expecting 'Packed direct dependency inventory mismatch'.

optionalFindings.reason: The new class duplicates FindRepositoryRoot, RunProjectCheck/AssertRejected and package-copy/version logic from DependencyBoundaryTests. It also uses compressed one-line blocks (`{ target.Remove(approved); }`, `using Stream output = ...; manifest.Save(output);`), which differ from the surrounding multi-line idiom. AGENTS.md asks for readable C# that matches the surrounding code.
optionalFindings.fix: Either fold the rows into DependencyBoundaryTests next to the existing RestoredGraph/Package tests, or keep the class and expand the one-liners to the file's normal brace and statement layout. Avoid adding a shared helper type unless the duplication grows.

optionalFindings.reason: Packed version validation is exact string equality. Semantically equivalent spellings such as '[10.0.12, )' are rejected as well as genuine tightening. This is conservative and acceptable, but the doc presents the exact-range row as detecting 'silent tightening' only.
optionalFindings.fix: Optionally note that any non-canonical version spelling is rejected, not only exact-pin ranges.

optionalFindings.fix: When the T02 receipt is recorded, change "remaining" to T03-T05 plus later WP07-WP09 and set T02 scopeStatus to reference the receipt.
